title: We are a small indie Studio looking for someone who is enthusiastic about AI to work with us.
author: dancingwithlies
selftext:
Hi, my name is Raian, i am part of the team on TapOrbit Studios, we are a small team with around 8 people based in Toronto Canada   
(Although I am the only one in the team that work outside of Canada, I live in Japan)  
  
I am the AI guy of the team, CEO is really interested in speeding up the game development progress after he hired me and saw the potential AI has on game dev.  
  
i am here to try and find someone that would help us, someone that has a decent knowledge on AI related stuff and game dev concepts, we dont need you to know how to code, but to know the underlying concepts of the systems you will work on, nothing scary tho i promise.  
  
The issue is that the team is on a tight runway budget, we are self funded, some people in the team are not getting paid, so right now we cant offer cash payment, but i have a pretty beef partnership with the AI providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, so i have a lot of usage to spare, as you can see in the images i am running mostly Fable 5 on max all the time.  
  
So because of that, I can offer you usage in exchange for work, but i want passion, not just someone that will do anything just to receive your usage, i want you to really love game dev and want to make a cool game you know, so i will provide usage to work on our game + usage for you to use personally on your own stuff as payment.   
  
I have 1+ years of experience in dealing with LLMs, so i can help you grow and learn how to properly use LLMs on day to day work and game dev, I made a lot of tools to help me on the game dev side and they could be useful for you as well. We might even be able to offer rev-share and payment in the future, we plan on launching a KIckstarter by September and if it works out we will upgrade everyone rewards as possible. You will need to sign a NDA contract tho, so that you will need to talk with the CEO, and the usage will come from me.   
  
Check more info on our Studio and members here; [https://taporbitstudios.ca/](https://taporbitstudios.ca/)   
(You can contact us from here too, but make sure to mention the "AI role" and my name "Raian", then we will hook up a interview with me and the CEO)   
  
Requirements we are looking for;

* Know how to manage usage, which model is good for what, i will provide usage but its not free, the least you use while doing the most you can is the target.
* Have some knowledge on game dev concepts, there is no need to know coding, we have experienced coders in the team that can help you if needed too
* Be enthusiastic about AI and the future that it opens up as a tool, as well as love game dev and put love into our game.
* Basic English skills, you dont need to be perfectly fluent, I make a lot of spelling mistakes xd (I am Brazilian)
* Want to improve and learn, and is eager to make something good, not just something "enough"

The game we are working right now is a Tactics open world game inspired by Final Fantasy Tactics and games like Wakfu etc.   
  
Btw I personally like to make a lot of tools to help us, because in my mind using AI is not just "i want a tree so make one" but "we can make a tool that makes tree as much as we need" that will help not only the current game but future ones as well.  
  
So yeah, if you are willing to give some of your time and love to other game in exchange for some personal usage too, then lets do it

[A little bit on how the game is looking rn, dont mind the lag i have 3 unity editors opened xd](https://reddit.com/link/1virklt/video/3fps9w2tc4ih1/player)

[One of my tools, this one is for procedural generated trees of all kinds, still being worked on, the leaves needs a rework. a have it completely functional for pixel art tho.](https://reddit.com/link/1virklt/video/6svdgj13d4ih1/player)

[Showing some of the usage i did this month.](https://preview.redd.it/e7cofxwfe4ih1.png?width=399&format=png&auto=webp&s=9e544ddc95117f9c9c45352dbb1ef1eaeab04e7d)

comments.author: Crafty-Run-6559

One small thing - Fable 5 on max is pretty much never worth it.

Youre better off using it on xhigh as an orchestrator and reviewer. Specifically allowing ultracode but telling it to use Opus 5 medium and sonnet subagents.

replies.author: Fuzzzy420

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: I am aware of that, i am just you know, showing off bcs the point here is that i usage to give.

replies.author: Crafty-Run-6559
replies.body:
Right - but arent you offering them that usage to help you build the game?

Thats pretty typical for a job. Your workplace supplies the tools.

For context my workplace supplies lots of people with 5k+ in usage per month, but that isn't payment. Its a tool.

If youre offering it for personal projects then thats more interesting.

But right now my max 20x account has consumed almost 10k in tokens at api rates this month (according to ccusage)... and it costs $200. 

Most people (and you) would be better off with $400/mo in stipends plus a revenue share. They'd almost certainly get more usage than what you would want to give out, and you'd be able to use that usage for building your product instead.

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body:
I am offering usage for their personal projects and i will cover our project too

So would be something like 5k for you to use on your personal projects and 5k for you to use on our game

replies.author: Crafty-Run-6559

That makes more sense.

Just pointing out that that 5k in personal usage is roughly a max 20x account (really its a good bit less).

So both you and them would be better off if you just offered to pay for a personal max 20x account for them.

comments.author: Patryk_Grzegorek
comments.body:
Hi Raian! This sounds like a great project, and I’m definitely interested in collaborating with TapOrbit Studios.

My name is Patryk Grzegorek, and I'm an AI researcher and software engineer focusing on AI integration in video games.

I ma building an AI System for Video Games inspired by Sword Art Online & Shangri-La Frontier, runs on Local AI.

I’ve been building an AI system for video games running on local AI. I recently published an awarded paper titled *"Intelligent NPC System with Narrative Consistency Using Local LLMs for Home Computers"*. Currently, the NPC has emotional states and player relationships, retains key facts via human-like imperfect memory, undergoes background events off-screen, and seamlessly understands its surrounding room, town layout, and dynamic inventory.

Beyond that:

* I have 2 more research papers accepted for an upcoming conference.
* I am currently working hard to finish 3 new papers before September 15th (the deadline for the next major conference).

Given your goal of building an open-world tactics game with smart LLM integration, I’d love to connect and see how my experience with LLMs and game world architecture could help the team.

Feel free to reach out to me here or check out my profile: [https://www.linkedin.com/in/patryk-grzegorek-love-it/](https://www.linkedin.com/in/patryk-grzegorek-love-it/)
